title: Recent progress in fluorescent chemosensors for selective aldehyde detection
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,10005-10021
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01010A, Review Article

Keshav Semwal, Avijit Kumar Das
Aldehydes (R-CHO) are reactive compounds in nature, industry, food, and metabolism, posing pollution and health risks. This review covers advances in optical chemosensors for aldehyde detection, highlighting novel designs and key sensing mechanisms.
